pattern: ^\[Win32App\]\[ReportingManager\] Execution state for app with id: {GUID} has been updated\. Report delta: \{"{1,2}EnforcementState"{1,2}:\{"{1,2}OldValue"{1,2}:"{1,2}InProgressPendingReboot"{1,2},"{1,2}NewValue"{1,2}:"{1,2}Success"{1,2}
description: Marks IME's check after the restart an installer requested. After an exit code mapped to SoftReboot or HardReboot the check right after the install decides nothing; after the restart IME moves the app from InProgressPendingReboot to Success (held back like after a clean install) and checks again without the IME-POST-INSTALL-DETECTION line. That check's result is reported as app_post_install_detection with afterReboot=true. Quote-flexible like IME-ENFORCEMENT-SUCCESS.
